info.title: Z-Medix API
info.description:
Z-Medix student-facing API.

Paths are written without the leading `/api` segment, matching the convention this collection already uses for the `/public/...` endpoints: the Apidog environment's base URL carries `/api`. The real Laravel routes are `/api/public/...`, `/api/student/...`.

Every `/student/...` endpoint is behind Laravel Sanctum (`auth:sanctum`) and needs an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

Successful responses use the envelope `{ success, message, data }` (plus `meta` and `links` on paginated lists). Failures use `{ success, message, errors }` with a stable `code` where the backend provides one.

post.description:
Confirms a one-time code against the authenticated student's **primary** phone number and marks it verified.

The number is resolved server-side from the authenticated user, so a code can never be applied to another account's phone; `phone`, `phone_id` and `e164_number` in the body are stripped and ignored.

Verification grants **no additional access** — it only flips `phone_verified` on the profile. If the number is already verified the call succeeds without consuming a code.

Each code allows a limited number of attempts (default 5). Every submission, right or wrong, consumes one. Once the allowance is spent the code is burned and a new one must be requested.

Changing the phone number through `POST /public/profile` resets it to pending and expires any outstanding code, so a code issued for the old number cannot verify the new one.

code.description: The numeric code delivered by SMS. 4–10 digits.

200.description: The number is verified. `data.user` is the refreshed profile with `phone_verified: true`.

401.description: No valid bearer token was supplied.

422.description: Wrong code (`PHONE_OTP_INVALID`), the code has expired (`PHONE_OTP_EXPIRED`), no code is outstanding (`PHONE_OTP_NOT_FOUND`), no phone is on record (`PHONE_NOT_FOUND`), or `code` failed validation.

429.description: The attempt allowance for this code is spent. Request a new code.

message.const: Maximum verification attempts exceeded. Please request a new code.

503.description: The verification provider could not be reached. The upstream message is logged, never returned.

message.const: We could not send a verification code right now. Please try again shortly.

post.description:
Sends a one-time verification code to the authenticated student's **primary** phone number via Twilio Verify.

The number is always resolved server-side from the authenticated user; any `phone`, `phone_id` or `e164_number` in the body is stripped and ignored.

Phone verification is **optional**. Nothing on the platform — registration, login, profile updates, studying, quizzes, fellowships or AI chat — is gated on a verified phone number. This endpoint exists only so a student who wants a verified number can obtain one.

Issuing a code expires any previous pending code for the same number. If the number is already verified the call succeeds without sending anything.

**Limits** — a resend cooldown (default 60s) and an hourly allowance (default 5), both scoped to the phone number, purpose and client IP, on top of a coarse `throttle:10,1` route limit. A failed delivery does not consume the allowance.

Upstream provider errors are never surfaced verbatim; they are logged and replaced by a generic `PHONE_OTP_SEND_FAILED`.

channel.description: Optional delivery channel. Defaults to `phone.default_channel` (sms). Must be one of `phone.supported_channels`.

200.description: Code sent, or the number was already verified.

message.example: We have sent a verification code to your phone number.

message.const: This phone number is already verified.

401.description: No valid bearer token was supplied.

422.description: No phone number on record (`PHONE_NOT_FOUND`), or the requested channel is not supported (validation error on `channel`).

message.example: No phone number is on record for this account. Please add one first.

429.description: Resend cooldown still active (`PHONE_OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN`) or the hourly allowance is spent (`PHONE_OTP_SEND_LIMIT_REACHED`). The coarse route throttle may also answer here without a `code`.

message.example: Please wait 42 seconds before requesting another verification code.

503.description: The verification provider could not be reached. The upstream message is logged, never returned.

message.const: We could not send a verification code right now. Please try again shortly.

post.description:
Opens a study-time tracking session on a subject. Call it when the student enters the subject's reading view, and keep the returned `id` for the matching end call.

Sessions are never closed automatically and more than one may be open at a time, so the frontend owns pairing a start with an end.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

subject_id.description: Id of an existing, non-deleted subject. Whether the student may study it is decided by the access service, not by validation.

post.description:
Closes a study session the student opened and stamps its `duration_seconds`. Call it when the student leaves the reading view.

Ending a session that has already ended is refused rather than re-stamped. A record that belongs to another student is reported as `404 NOT_FOUND` rather than `403`, so the API never confirms that it exists.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

Where the student left off in a subject, so the frontend can offer "Continue". Call it when the subject is opened.

A chapter with its ordered page list (page bodies excluded), its quiz summary, this student's reading progress and its `references`. Call it when the student opens a chapter from the subject's chapter list.

Access is validated on every request rather than assumed from the client's navigation: a chapter whose predecessor is unfinished is refused with `403 CHAPTER_LOCKED`.

`references` is the chapter's free-text source list — nullable, at most 255 characters.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

post.description:
Enters the chapter's quiz. An attempt left in progress is resumed with its original question order; otherwise a new attempt is opened.

The status distinguishes the two: `201` for a new attempt (`Quiz attempt started.`), `200` for a resumed one (`Quiz attempt resumed.`).

The student may enter without having read every page of the chapter. Chapter quiz attempts are a separate flow from Fellowship sessions and never mix with them.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

get.description:
The state of one attempt: its fixed question order, the answers already locked in, the running tally, and `current_question_id` — the question the student is on. Call it to re-enter an attempt, and to review a completed one.

The attempt carries no timer and no pass mark: the only clock the student sees belongs to their study session.

**Historical snapshots.** Every question is rendered from the attempt's frozen snapshot, so later admin edits never change what a past attempt shows. An attempt snapshotted before question titles and option explanations existed simply carries `title: null` and options with `explanation: null`; the response shape is unchanged.

A record that belongs to another student is reported as `404 NOT_FOUND` rather than `403`, so the API never confirms that it exists.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

post.description:
Submits a final answer to one question of an attempt, and returns both the graded question and the attempt's refreshed state.

**Addressing.** `quizAttemptQuestion` is the attempt's own question row id — the `id` on `questions[]` — not the live question id. That is what keeps an attempt answerable after the original question is deleted.

**Disclosure.** This response is the first point at which correctness is revealed: `is_correct`, `correct_option_key`, `correct_option_text`, `selected_option_explanation` and the per-option `explanation` / `is_correct` keys appear only on an answered question.

**Finality.** An answer is final; a second submission is refused rather than overwriting the first, which is what makes a double-clicked submit harmless. Answering the last open question completes the attempt and the chapter, which the returned attempt state reflects.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

get.description:
The Question Bank screen: every active Fellowship with this student's standing in it. Call it when the Question Bank opens.

The screen lists Fellowships, not questions — the student picks a bank and generates sessions from it. Inactive Fellowships are never listed. Ordered by name, not paginated.

`average_score` is the module's single accuracy figure: correct confirmed answers over all confirmed answers. The frontend labels it "Completion Rate" here and "Average Score" inside a Fellowship; the name differs, the number does not. It is null until the student has confirmed an answer, so a new student is shown no score rather than a zero.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

200.description: Active Fellowships.

get.description:
The Fellowship dashboard: identity, totals, accuracy, day streak, study time, daily study series, per-difficulty and per-topic performance, and recent activity. Call it when the student opens a Fellowship.

Every figure aggregates the student's confirmed answers across **all** of their sessions in this Fellowship — paused and unfinished ones included — and counts a question answered again in a later session as a second answer. A session's own result screen reports the same kinds of figures scoped to that session alone.

`topics_completed` is the number of distinct Performance Topics the student has answered at least one question in; it is not how many topics they have exhausted.

An inactive Fellowship is reported as `404 FELLOWSHIP_UNAVAILABLE` rather than forbidden: it is content that is not on offer.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

parameters.description: Length of the `daily_study_time` window, in days. Clamped to 1-90; defaults to 7.

get.description:
Everything the Generate Session form needs to offer: this Fellowship's own dynamic filters and their values, the difficulty levels, the question statuses, the size of the bank, the per-question time limit a timed session would snapshot, and the maximum question count. Call it when the Generate Session form opens.

The filters are per-Fellowship, so another Fellowship's classifications never appear here. `is_performance` marks the Fellowship's required Performance Topic classification — exactly one filter carries it, every question in the bank holds one of its values, and Topic Performance analytics are reported by those values. It is offered for narrowing like any other filter and flagged so the frontend can give it the prominence it has elsewhere. A Fellowship whose classification has not been designated yet has no filter with this flag.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

200.description: The form's options.

total_questions.description: Questions currently available in this Fellowship's whole bank, before any filtering. Not the same as Count Available Questions' `available_questions`, which is the filtered, per-student eligible count.

question_time_limit_seconds.description: The platform-wide advisory limit per question, which a timed session would snapshot. There is no total session limit.

max_question_count.description: The configurable system ceiling `question_count` is validated against, on both Count Available Questions and Generate Session. The form's effective maximum is `min(max_question_count, available_questions)`.

404.description: The Fellowship does not exist or is inactive.

post.description:
How many questions a given set of filters would actually yield for this student, so the form can tell them before they commit rather than only refusing afterwards. Call it whenever the Generate Session form's filters change.

Counted with exactly the query generation draws from, so the two can never disagree. Nothing is created.

This endpoint no longer shares Generate Session's own requirements, only its filter semantics. **`title` is not required** — counting names nothing — and it is still accepted and ignored, so a client already sending one keeps working. **`question_count` is optional**: send it when the form needs to know whether a specific size could be generated, omit it when the form only needs the availability figure.

With a `question_count`, `requested_question_count` echoes it and `can_generate` is `available_questions >= question_count`. Without one, `requested_question_count` is `null` and `can_generate` reports only whether a session could be generated at all (`available_questions >= min_question_count`, which is 1).

The frontend's effective maximum for the size field is `min(max_question_count, available_questions)` — `max_question_count` from Get Fellowship Filters is the configurable system ceiling, `available_questions` is what these filters actually hold.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

title.description: Optional and ignored. Accepted only so a client written against the previously shared request body keeps working; counting does not name anything. At most 255 characters when sent.

question_count.description: Optional. How many questions the student is asking about. When sent it must be between `min_question_count` (1) and `max_question_count` (200 by default; the live ceiling is reported by Get Fellowship Filters), and it drives `requested_question_count` and `can_generate`. Omit it to ask only how many questions the filters hold.

timer_enabled.description: Optional, defaults to false. When true the session snapshots the platform's per-question time limit; the verdict it produces is advisory and never affects a score.

difficulties.description: Optional. Omit, or send an empty array, for all difficulties.

question_status.description: Optional, defaults to `all`. Narrows to questions this student has or has not already answered.

filters.description: Optional. Keyed by filter id, each holding the chosen value ids within that filter. Choosing several values inside one filter widens the pool; choosing values in more than one filter narrows it. Omitting a filter means All. Only values belonging to this Fellowship are accepted.

200.description: The pool these filters would draw from. With `question_count` omitted, `requested_question_count` is `null`: `{"available_questions": 7, "requested_question_count": null, "can_generate": true}`.

available_questions.description: How many questions these filters yield for this student right now.

requested_question_count.description: The `question_count` that was sent, echoed back unchanged, or `null` when none was sent. Never invented.

can_generate.description: With a `question_count`: `available_questions >= question_count`. Without one: whether a session could be generated at all, i.e. `available_questions >= min_question_count` (1).

404.description: The Fellowship does not exist or is inactive.

422.description: Validation failed — a filter value belonging to another Fellowship, an unknown difficulty, or a `question_count` outside 1…`max_question_count`. A missing `title` is no longer a validation failure.

example.message: One of the selected filter values does not belong to this fellowship.

filters.12.0: One of the selected filter values does not belong to this fellowship.

post.description:
Generates a new quiz session over this Fellowship's bank and returns it with its full question list and the question the student starts on. Call it when the Generate Session form is submitted.

**Filtering.** Only `title` and `question_count` are required; every narrowing is optional and omitting one means All, so a request with nothing but a title and a count draws from the whole bank. `filters` is keyed by filter id. `question_status` selects answered, unanswered or all questions for this student. `difficulties` narrows by difficulty.

**All-or-nothing.** If the filters cannot fill `question_count`, nothing is created and the `422 FELLOWSHIP_INSUFFICIENT_QUESTIONS` response reports `errors.available_questions` so the form can say what it could have given them.

**Ordering.** The generated question order is fixed at creation and the session is answered through it in sequence; `current_position` is persisted, so reviewing earlier answers does not move the student's place.

**Timer.** With `timer_enabled` the session snapshots the platform's per-question limit into `question_time_limit_seconds`; raising the platform limit later never re-judges a running session. There is no total session limit, and the per-question verdict is advisory. The first question's clock starts with the session, at generation — its `activated_at` is the session's own `started_at`, so the frontend should show the first question as soon as this response arrives rather than after a further call.

A student may hold any number of sessions on one Fellowship. Fellowship sessions are a separate flow from chapter quiz attempts.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

parameters.name: fellowship
parameters.description: Id of the Fellowship to generate from. Never taken from the body.

title.description: Required. The session's name, at most 255 characters. Trimmed.

question_count.description: Required. How many questions to draw. Between `min_question_count` (1) and `max_question_count` (200 by default; the live ceiling is reported by Get Fellowship Filters).

post.description:
Submits a final answer to the question the session is on, and returns both the graded question and the session's refreshed state.

**Addressing.** `fellowshipSessionQuestion` is the session's own question row id — the `id` on `questions[]` — not the live Fellowship question id. That is what keeps a session answerable after the original question is edited or deleted.

**Sequence.** Questions are answered in order: submitting against anything other than the current one is refused with `FELLOWSHIP_QUESTION_OUT_OF_ORDER`. A paused session must be resumed first (`FELLOWSHIP_SESSION_NOT_IN_PROGRESS`).

**Disclosure.** This response is the first point at which the correct option and the explanations are disclosed: `is_correct`, `correct_option_key`, `correct_option_text`, `explanation`, `selected_option_explanation` and the per-option `explanation` / `is_correct` keys appear only on an answered question.

**Finality.** An answer is final; submitting twice is refused rather than overwriting the first. Answering the last open question completes the session, which the returned session state reflects.

`answered_within_time` is informational: it says whether a timed question was answered inside its limit, is null when timing was off, and takes no part in `is_correct` or any score.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

get.description:
Every attempt this student has made on a chapter's quiz, newest first and paginated — how they find the past attempts they can review. Attempts are kept permanently, so this list only grows.

The questions stay out deliberately: a history list is for choosing which attempt to review, and Get Quiz Attempt State then serves the frozen questions and answers of the one chosen.

Scores come from the same formula the attempt endpoint uses, so a row here and the attempt it links to can never report different numbers. `percentage` counts unanswered questions against the attempt, so an unfinished attempt scores low rather than null; `average_score` is correct over *answered* and is null until something is answered.

**Authentication** — requires a Sanctum bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). The whole `/student` tree is behind `auth:sanctum`; an unauthenticated call is answered with `401`.

parameters.name: chapter
parameters.description: Id of the chapter whose quiz history is being read.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page. Defaults to 15, clamped to 1-50 rather than rejected.

200.description: A page of attempt history.

example.message: Complete the previous chapter to unlock this one.

404.description: The chapter has no quiz, or the quiz is not available.

is_email_verified.description: Retained for the existing contract; same value as `email_verified`.

phone.description: E.164 form of the student's primary phone number, or null when none is on record.

phone_verified.description: Whether the number reported in `phone` is verified. False when no phone exists. Read-only: it is derived from the phone's own status and can never be set through a request.

errors.description: Additional failure context. Empty for most business failures.

code.description: Stable machine-readable identifier for the failure. Absent on failures raised without one (for example a 422 validation failure).

ChapterPageSummary.description: A study page without its body. Returned inside a chapter's page list and after marking a page complete.

position.description: 1-based position of the page inside its chapter.

is_completed.description: Whether this student has marked the page as read.

ChapterPage.description: A study page with its body. Only the single-page endpoint returns `content`.

position.description: 1-based position of the page inside its chapter.

content.description: The page body (rich text / HTML as stored).

references.description: Free-text source references for the chapter. Nullable, at most 255 characters.

is_completed.description: Whether this student has completed the chapter (all pages read and, where present, the quiz finished).

pages.description: Ordered page list without page bodies.

duration_seconds.description: Set when the session is ended. Null while it is still open.

StudyResume.description: `chapter_page` and `quiz_attempt` are never both set: the student stopped either on a page or inside a quiz.

has_position.description: False for a student who has not studied this subject yet; the other fields then describe the starting point.

selected_text.description: The passage the note was written against. Set on creation and never editable.

QuizOptionPresentable.description: An option as shown before the question is answered: key and text only. Neither `is_correct` nor `explanation` is present.

QuizOptionRevealed.description: An option as shown after the question is answered.

explanation.description: Why this option is right or wrong. Null when the captured option carries none, including snapshots taken before option explanations existed.

QuizAttemptQuestion.description: One question inside an attempt, rendered entirely from the attempt's frozen snapshot. Correctness is disclosed only once the question is answered: until then the options carry no `is_correct` and no `explanation` key at all.

id.description: The attempt's own question row. Answers are submitted against this id, not against `question_id`.

question_id.description: The live question this row was captured from. Null once that question is deleted.

title.description: The question's own heading, captured with it. Null for a question with no title and for an attempt snapshotted before titles existed.

explanation.description: Question-level explanation captured in the snapshot. Currently always null: `questions` carries no explanation column yet.

options.description: `QuizOptionPresentable` while `is_answered` is false, `QuizOptionRevealed` once it is true.

is_correct.description: Null until the question is answered.

correct_option_key.description: Null until the question is answered.

correct_option_text.description: Null until the question is answered.

selected_option_explanation.description: Explanation of the option the student picked. Null until the question is answered, and null when that option carries none.

QuizAttempt.description: A chapter quiz attempt carries no timer and no pass mark.

score.description: Correct answers, as a raw count.

average_score.description: Correct over answered questions, 0-100. Null until something is answered.

current_question_id.description: The `questions[].id` the student is on. Null once every question is answered.

FellowshipPerformanceTopic.description: One value of the Fellowship's Performance Topic filter.

average_score.description: Correct confirmed answers over all confirmed answers, 0-100. Null until the student has confirmed an answer. Labelled "Completion Rate" on the Question Bank screen.

FellowshipQuizPerformance.description: One row per difficulty. Every difficulty is present, with zeroes and a null score where the student has answered nothing.

FellowshipDetails.description: Every figure aggregates the student's confirmed answers across all of their sessions in this Fellowship, paused ones included.

total_questions.description: Questions currently available in this Fellowship's bank.

topics_completed.description: Distinct Performance Topics the student has answered at least one question in. Not how many topics they have exhausted.

daily_study_time.description: One entry per day in the requested window, oldest first, zero-filled.

is_performance.description: Marks the Fellowship's required Performance Topic classification.

FellowshipSessionQuestion.description: One question inside a session, rendered entirely from the session's frozen snapshot. Correctness and every explanation are disclosed only once the question is answered.

id.description: The session's own question row. Answers are submitted against this id, not against `fellowship_question_id`.

fellowship_question_id.description: The live question this row was captured from. Null once that question is force-deleted.

title.description: The question's own heading, captured with it. Null for a question with no title and for a session snapshotted before titles existed.

performance_topic.description: The Performance Topic captured with the question.

filters.description: The question's captured classifications across every filter of its Fellowship.

options.description: `QuizOptionPresentable` while `is_answered` is false, `QuizOptionRevealed` once it is true.

is_correct.description: Null until the question is answered.

correct_option_key.description: Null until the question is answered.

correct_option_text.description: Null until the question is answered.

explanation.description: Question-level explanation from the snapshot. Null until the question is answered, and null when the captured question carries none.

selected_option_explanation.description: Explanation of the option the student picked. Null until the question is answered, and null when that option carries none.

answered_within_time.description: Advisory only: whether a timed question was answered inside its limit. Null when the session was generated with timing off. Takes no part in `is_correct` or in any score.

elapsed_seconds.description: Active time already spent on this question, so a resumed session can show the remaining time rather than restarting the clock.

question_count.description: The number of questions the session was generated with.

current_position.description: Persisted rather than inferred, so reviewing earlier answers does not move the student's place.

current_question_id.description: The `questions[].id` the student is on. Null once the session is completed.

question_time_limit_seconds.description: The limit this session was generated under, not the platform's current one. Null when timing was disabled.

performance_topics.description: The distinct Performance Topic values present in this session.

average_score.description: Scoped to this session. Null until an answer is confirmed.

FellowshipSessionSummary.description: One row of Session History. Every figure is scoped to that session.

can_resume.description: True for any session that is not completed, including a paused one.

can_view_result.description: True only for a completed session. The result endpoint itself accepts a session in any state.

questions.description: Every question in order, for the answer review.

pdf_url.description: Public URL of the attached PDF, or null when none is attached.

ValidationError.description: Laravel's default 422 body, used wherever a form request fails validation.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.

percentage.description: 0-100, rounded to two decimal places. 0 when the subject has no published chapter.

books_count.description: Published platform books in the subject.

SubjectChapterRow.description: One chapter of a subject's track, without page bodies.

is_accessible.description: The backend's own answer to whether the student may open this chapter yet, decided by the rule the chapter endpoint enforces. Drawing a locked chapter as unlocked does not unlock it.

type.description: `pdf` is opened as a file, `content` as a sequence of pages.

has_pdf.description: True only for a `pdf` book that actually has a file attached.

pages_count.description: Present for a `content` book, null for a `pdf` one.

chapters.description: The subject's published chapter track, in order.

books.description: The subject's published platform books. Independent of the chapter track: a book never parents a chapter and a chapter never parents a book.

SubjectOverallResult.description: The subject's overall quiz result, aggregated over every attempt the student has made in it.

average_score.description: Correct over answered, 0-100. Null until the student has answered a question in this subject.

hours.description: The same figure as `seconds`, for display.

SubjectChapterQuizPerformance.description: One row per chapter of the subject that has a quiz.

average_score.description: Correct over answered across every attempt on this chapter's quiz. Null when nothing has been answered.

best_score.description: The highest single-attempt percentage. Null when there is no attempt.

latest_score.description: The most recent attempt's percentage. Null when there is no attempt.

SubjectStatistics.description: Every figure is counted from the student's own recorded activity at request time. Nothing here is stored or estimated.

study_time_hours.description: The same figure as `study_time_seconds`, for display.

daily_study_time.description: One entry per day in the requested window, oldest first, zero-filled.

Book.description: The other type's fields are null rather than absent, so the client's shape does not change between a PDF and a content book.

pdf_url.description: The platform book's public media URL. Present for a `pdf` book with a file, null otherwise and always null for a `content` book.

position.description: 1-based position across the whole book, derived from the page's place in the listing.

pdf_url.description: Path of the authenticated download route, not a public URL. The file lives on the private disk and is only ever served through that route.

Bookmark.description: A place the student marked to come back to. It carries no writing of their own, so there is no update: it is created and removed only.

AnnotationContext.description: Where the annotation sits, so a collection screen can offer a way back to the chapter it came from. Null when the page relation could not be resolved.

HighlightWithContext.description: A highlight as the collection screen lists it. `context` is added only there; the per-page payload is unchanged.

NoteWithContext.description: A note as the collection screen lists it. `context` is added only there; the per-page payload is unchanged.

BookmarkWithContext.description: A bookmark as the collection screen lists it. `context` is added only there; the per-page payload is unchanged.

QuizAttemptSummary.description: One row of a chapter quiz's attempt history, without its questions. Scored through the same formula the attempt endpoint uses, so a row and the attempt it links to can never disagree.

score.description: Correct answers, as a raw count. The same number as `correct_answers`.

percentage.description: Correct over total questions, 0-100. Counts unanswered questions against the attempt, so an unfinished attempt scores low rather than null.

average_score.description: Correct over answered questions, 0-100. Null until something is answered.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
